# commit

## Steps
1. `git status --short`, then `node .agents/scripts/owner.mjs --diff` to group files by owning agent; one logical change per commit.
2. Leave out anything that isn't code or docs: `.env*`, `backend/.vault-dev/`, real student data, local port tweaks. Tell the user what was left out.
3. Stage explicit paths only (`git add path1 path2`); `git add -A`, `.` and `commit -a` are blocked by a hook. Use `git add -p` when a file mixes concerns.
4. Message: `type(scope): imperative lower-case summary`, with `Refs #n` / `Closes #n` in the footer. Types: `feat fix docs style refactor perf test build ci chore revert`.
5. Check `git status` after the last commit.

## Rules
Don't push, amend or rewrite history unless asked.
